tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Enterprise shall be registered with the Director of Industries and Commerce, Government of Karnataka as a Micro and Small Enterprises. (As per notification no: FD 130 Exp-12/2015 dated 10.10.2017).
EMD of Rs. 47,046/- in should be credited to CeG account as per IFT Clause (4).
Details of Income Tax returns filed for the Financial Years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 (i.e., Assessment Year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 respectively).

The tenderer should be a manufacturer and if the company is registered under MSME must have manufactured 40% of the tender quantity (322400envelopes) in last 2 years. Past experience of the same in the format mentioned under Section XII along with work orders must be uploaded. (As per G.O no: FD 908 Exp-12/2019 Bengaluru dated 21.07.2020).

Copy of the PAN card of the firm has to be uploaded as detailed below If a firm is sole proprietorship PAN card copy of the proprietorship If a firm is partnership PAN card copy of the firm only (partners PAN card copy will not be considered) If a firm is private Ltd., or Public Ltd., Company, PAN card copy of the company.
The Tenderer shall be either proprietorship or partnership firm or a company registered under the companies Act 1956 or a registered society

The tenderer shall submit samples of the Paper to the Senior Assistant Director, B Section, Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board as mentioned in e-procurement.These samples are to be packed in covers duly indicating name and address of the tenderer on the sealed cover and on all the samples. The tenders without the samples shall be categorically rejected. The samples shall bare the manufacturers name, brand, GSM etc
Audited balance sheet and Profit and Loss account for the Financial Years 2022-23 and 2023-24, 2024-25 (i.e., Assessment Year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 respectively) has to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The average annual financial turnover should not be less than Rs.24 lakhs in the last three Financial Years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 (i.e., Assessment Year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 respectively). For companies registered under MSME (MSME certificate to be submitted for any claims), average annual financial turnover should not be less than Rs.12 lakhs in the last two Financial Years 2023-24 and 2024-25 (i.e., Assessment 2024-25 , & 2025-26 respectively). (As per G.O no: FD 908 Exp-12/2019 Bengaluru dated 21.07.2020).
